description: A warm, friendly woman in her thirties or forties with a clear, natural, mid-pitched voice, a native Spanish speaker with a neutral Latin American (Mexican) accent. She says a short prayer aloud the way people say it together in church every day: fluent and flowing, at a normal conversational speed, warm and sincere, without dragging and without dramatic pauses.
ref_text: Gloria al Padre, y al Hijo, y al Espíritu Santo. Como era en el principio, ahora y siempre, por los siglos de los siglos. Amén.
